name: SKIRTS IN WINE CONCERT CONCERT @ HAVEN
description:
Join us at Haven on Friday, November 1st, for an unforgettable evening of live music! Headlining the night are newcomers Skirts in Wine, alongside two amazing solo acts and an incredible sister-duo 🎶 With a packed program of diverse sounds and performances, this is a night you won’t want to miss!

Here’s what’s in store:

🎸 SKIRTS IN WINE
Prepare for an intense musical journey, where loud rock collides with intimate lyrics. Their debut single, "Taste of Summer," tells a gripping story of overcoming mental illness and emerging into the light—crafted by four friends who’ve been on this musical path together for years.

🎧 SALLY F
Sally F’s world is electronic, raw, and irresistibly captivating. Her music is driven by pulsating beats, bold synths, and vocals that range from light and airy to powerful and commanding, all wrapped in infectious pop melodies. She transforms themes like perfectionism, uncertainty, and self-doubt into a message of strength and liberation.

🎤 TTOP
TTOP, a Danish-language indie pop duo formed by sisters Thilde and Freja Top, offers a dreamy and experimental universe that feels both intimate and honest. Their music navigates the space between vulnerability and everyday life. With vocals that are delicate yet commanding, the sisters blend raw emotion with tender melodies, capturing both their shared perspectives and individual differences in a sound that’s equal parts vulnerable and defiant.

🎶 MARIA LÆRKE
Maria Lærke’s music strikes a balance between the delicate and the dark. With a deep focus on lyrical storytelling, she seamlessly weaves the Danish language into soft, captivating melodies. Her songs paint vivid, emotional landscapes, drawing listeners so deeply into her world that it feels like you're right there in the moment. Her sound is as intimate as it is evocative, creating a unique connection through her words and melodies.

With a lineup this exciting, you won’t want to miss a single moment—so be here by 18:30 if you want to catch all the incredible performances from start to finish!

name: Jægersborggade Halloween 2024
description:
Uhhh.. hyggelig HALLOWEEN i Jægersborggade🎃

Traditionen tro - inviterer vi alle børn og voksne til Jægersborggade HALLOWEEN, når mørket har sænket sig over Jægersborggade torsdag d. 31. oktober 2023 fra kl.17.00-19.00🎃

Gratis event - støttet af Nørrebro Lokaludvalg🎃

Kom udklædt og trick-or-treat i gadens mange butikker, som denne ene aften forvandles til frygtindgydende, bloddryppende spindelvævskabinetter med spøgelser, zombier, genfærd og hundredevis af lysende græskarre i månens dunkle skær - fyldt med uhh-hyggelige mængder slik🎃

Program:
- De fleste butikker er åbne og har gratis slik til børn.
- Skrækindjagende halloween-dans gennem gaden med 25 zombie-dansere fra Global Kidz
🎃
- I Den Sidste Dråbe spiller zombieorganisten op til gotisk dans, der er billige bloody Marys til de voksne og klamt slik til børnene…
- NOABURO går i rødt - som i blod-rødt - og inviterer “venner” fra kirkegården på besøg🎃
- Besøg Flagermusegrotten hos Malene Glintborg. Måske de deler ud af nattens slikfangst🦇🍭
- Det kribler og krabler hos Tú a Tú og vores orange græskarspande er fyldte til randen med slik🕷️🎃
- Keramiker Inge Vincents åbner op til Spooky House med spooky lyde, edderkopper og slik🎃
- GRØD serverer græskarrisotto, orange gulerodsjuice og uddeler slik til børnene🎃
- Damerne i My Favourite Things kanaliserer deres indre hekse ud - det er forbavsende let! Og temmelig uhyggeligt🎃
- Meyers uddeler de uhyggeligt gode kanelsnurre til udklædte børn - så længe lager haves🎃
- UGood serverer sprøde, brækkede knogler med frisktappet blod aka. cassava fries med ketchup og uddeler slik til børnene🎃
- Hos Raske Planter mindes de døde ved Samhain-alteret, mens der spilles dødsmetal og serveres slik fra den rygende gryde🎃
- Tricotage sørger for masser af slik🎃
- Gys og monstre foran Tante Tot 
- Craft Sisters har uhyggelige mængder af slik til alle børnene🎃
- Plant har i anledningen af Halloween mini stikkende kaktusser og skøre sukkulenter til børneværelserne for kun 10kr stk🪴

Programmet opdateres løbende med arrangementer fra gadens +50 butikker🎃

Vi glæder os til at skræmme jer og få en uhh.. hyggelig aften med jer allesammen🎃

Hjemsøgte, bloddryppende og græskarudskårne hilsner fra
Butikkerne i Jægersborggade

PS. TAK fordi I støtter det fysiske handelsliv❤️

name: Otherness // MIX CPH 2024
description:
OTHERNESS

Alba Cros Pellisé / Spain / 2023 / 91 min / Catalan and Spanish with English subtitles

Four generations of the lesbian community in Catalonia are given a platform to speak for themselves, sharing the experience of being a LGBTQIA+ person living in a predominantly heterosexual world through incredibly intimate anecdotes. This emotional film offers a glimpse into lives we may never have imagined.

name: What Happens to Dreams Deferred? // MIX CPH 2024
description:
From finding ourselves in our youth to getting out in the “real world” we are always exploring new ways of being - alone and together, especially in an unwelcoming or violent society. Existence is always interlinked and communal; we don't make it alone. Complete strangers, lovers, friends, entire neighborhoods, or even people who stay with us beyond life; we come together to walk further, to support, to witness, to belong. This program comprised of different QTIBIPOC stories is for you, for building with us.

+ QTIBIPOC stands for "Queer, Trans, Intersex / Black, Indigenous, People of Colour".

About the short films: 
>> Welcome to Celibacy Club
Campbell Moore / USA / 2023 / 16 min / English without subtitles
A coming-of-age short film about identifying as asexual in a world of sex and sensuality.

>> My Heart Is Going to Explode
Jung In-hyuk / South Korea / 2023 / 20 min / Korean with English subtitles
Soojin is taken on a chaotic journey that tests the strength of her heart. In this B-grade humour short full of invading aliens, sci-fi, action-romance, and clichés, a UFO appears in the sky over Seoul. Together with the green-lit girl she met last night, she strives to save the city.

>> Beach
Anisha Sharma/ India / 2023 / 15 min / Hindi with English subtitles
Karan is a trans man who has recently undergone gender-affirming surgery, and going to the beach shirtless has been a dream and act of liberation for him. His supportive cis friend Aditya, who always stands up for him, accompanies him on this journey. Will Karan have the courage to go shirtless on the beach? Will he achieve his dream and feel liberated?

>> Apartment 605
Bianca Catbagan / The Philippines / 2023 / 7 min / English, French and Tagalog with subtitles for the Tagalog
Mika packs up their late father’s apartment when they are interrupted by the buzzer. Over the course of a conversation separated by the building’s intercom, we learn of the visitor's connection with the apartment's owner, Mika’s estranged father.

>> MnM
Twiggy Pucci Garçon / USA / 2023 / 22 min / English without subtitles
MnM is an exuberant portrait of chosen sisters Mermaid and Milan, two emerging runway divas in the drag ballroom community. Celebrating their joy, siblinghood, and unapologetic personas, the film explores the power and beauty of being non-binary in a community that prizes gender ‘realness’.

>> Unless We Dance 
Hanz Rippe Gabriele, Fernanda Pineda Palencia / Colombia / 2023 / 15 min / Spanish with English subtitles
In Quibdó, Columbia, Bonays and hundreds of young people come together through dance as their act of resilience to the violence of the city.

name: This Is How We Do It “10 Year Anniversary” // MIX CPH 2024
description:
THIS IS HOW WE DO IT "10 YEAR ANNIVERSARY"

For ten lustful years, 'This is How We Do It' has been celebrating authentic queer desires, turning up the heat on Cinemateket's big screen. This year isn’t just any anniversary—it’s a celebration of a decade spent delivering the raw, the real, and the irresistible. This special edition showcases a handpicked selection of the hottest films from past programs, each one a testament to the evolving and diverse world of queer porn. Get ready to relive the 'aaaaahs' and 'ooooohs' that have kept you coming back, begging for more. Join us for unforgettable moments, sultry surprises, and boundary-pushing brilliance.

Trust us—you won’t want to miss this salacious celebration.

+ Raffle with Peech

About the films: 
>> Hello Titty
*MIX CPH 2015 OFFICIAL SELECTION*
Skyler Braedon Fox/ Germany / 2014 / 15 min / English without subtitles
Tit Star Showboy is wrapping up his career as a tit flasher, and is offering one last round of private viewings in his trailer. The queers come flocking to see the show, and in their anticipation, a power struggle develops over who will be the first to enter. 

>> Crystal Clear
*MIX CPH 2017 OFFICIAL SELECTION*
Max Disgrace / UK / 2017 / 4 min/ English without subtitles
An erotic narration of a date unfolds, packed with fantasy, expectations, and unnecessary emotional baggage, all while we watch from a face-sitting, boob-smothering point of view.

>> Internal Energy
*MIX CPH 2018 OFFICIAL SELECTION*
Aorta Films / USA / 2017 / 12 min / English without subtitles
Internal energy is the energy of the whole, created by the positions and interactions of its parts. Knox bites, grabs, and holds, inflicting intense sensations all over Ohms' body. She absorbs everything and releases in a beautiful vociferation.
- Content Warning: heavy impact play

>> Tidal
*MIX CPH 2019 OFFICIAL SELECTION*
Dwam Ipomée / France / 2018 / 7min / No dialogue
Immersive ASMR porn for hands & skin fetishists.

>> Orgy #001
*MIX CPH 2020 OFFICIAL SELECTION*
Aorta Films / USA / 2017 / 11min / English without subtitles
Five beautiful queers unite in an afternoon of playful intimacy. Three business partners and two magic wands add to the mix as they bite, suck, and fist their way to a joyful climax. Bathed in afternoon light, they revel in the joy of touch, holding each other down until they reach a gasping, radiant finish.

>> Fuses
*MIX CPH 2021 OFFICIAL SELECTION*
Four Chambers / UK / 2020 / 8 min / English without subtitles
'Fuses', a 1967 film by Carolee Schneemann, explored the merging of bodies in intimate, explicit sex. This short film, inspired by Schneemann, reimagines "fusing" for the digital age. Shot during the pandemic, it blends projected images of distant performers with the filmmaker's body, capturing the fusion of physical and digital intimacy across spaces.

>> Pista
*MIX CPH 2023 OFFICIAL SELECTION*
Ediy Porn / Brazil / 2023 / 14 min / No dialogue
Ledah and Clemix activate the sounds that groove José, Larissa, and Luxúria in a seductive dance that transforms the dance floor into a sensual space of lust and affection.

>> Shower Me
*MIX CPH 2024 OFFICIAL SELECTION*
Mahx Capacity / USA / 2024 / 13 min / English without subtitles
Meet Robin Astera and Lina Bembe, a real-life couple. In this film, they get hot, wet, and clean before getting dirty in this steamy short.
- Content Warning: peeing

>> Gay*Watch Berlin
*MIX CPH 2022 OFFICIAL SELECTION*
Hanna Schaich / Germany / 2021 / 13 min / English with English subtitles
'GAY*WATCH BERLIN' is a queer empowerment sing-a-long video. The work celebrates togetherness, sexual liberation and is a manifesto of hope and strength. 'GAY*WATCH BERLIN' strengthens the subcultural context and overcomes a feeling of powerlessness through lightness.

name: Olla Común 🥘 - South American Community Kitchen
description:
******ENGLISH BELOW******
Hola a todes
Les esperamos este jueves a las 18.00 en el primer piso de La Casa del Pueblo para la Olla Comun de cada mes. La comida se sirve a las 18.30 masomenos

Como el zapallo esta en temporada, se los vamos a cocinar un Locro de Zapallo peruano. La comida es vegana!

En esta Olla tenemos una charla de Fernando Racimo - profesor asociado de la Universidad de Copenhague. La charla sera sobre decrecimiento. Fernando trabaja como académico y es tambien activista en varios movimientos climaticos y anti-coloniales en Dinamarca, incluyendo Scientist Rebellion y Academics for Palestine. Su charla se centrará en explicar qué significa que una economía decrezca, en exponer por qué el paradigma de "decrecimiento" ha cobrado relevancia en los últimos años, y en abrir un debate colectivo sobre estrategias para construir juntos un futuro "post-crecimiento", con justicia ecológica y social para todes.

La anterior Olla donamos lo recaudado a comunidades en Brazil afectadas por los incendios en el amazonas. Asi que esta vez mandaremos lo recaudado a comunidades en el este de Bolivia donde el problema continua. Aqui se los dejamos un video de Radio Deseo dirijido por Mujeres Creando donde enfrentan a uno de las autoridades de bosques: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lyzo_j-CVzM

Nos vemos!!

Se puede pagar con cash y tambien con MobilePay :)

-----------------------------------
Hi everyone!
Join us this Thursday for the monthly Olla Comun at 18.00 at the first floor of FolketsHus. Food is served at 18.30

This time we'll do some seasonal cross over and do a peruvian Pumpkin Locro (stew) 😋 we'll veganize it as always

This Olla we are happy to host a talk by Fernando Racimo - associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The talk will be about degrowth. Fernando works as an academic and is also an activist in several climate and anti-colonial movements in Denmark, including Scientist Rebellion and Academics for Palestine. His talk will focus on explaining what it means for an economy to degrow, on why the ‘degrowth’ paradigm has gained prominence in recent years, and on opening a collective debate on strategies to build together a ‘post-growth’ future, with ecological and social justice for all.

As the fires in the Amazon in Brazil and Bolivia continue, and because the last Olla's donation were sent to Brazil. This time we'll send the donations to communities in Bolivia still affected. Here is a video with more info about the situation in Bolivia:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EhPiiBovPbM

See you on Thursday! For donations we take cash and MobilePay
